notes: considered well was left indivisible: neither considered nor well writes the lexeme of שִׁית or of לֵב, so rule 30's subtraction finds no morpheme owning a part and rule 6's first-token fallback supplies the source anchor.
The suffix of לִבִּי is unrepresented, the ASV writing no possessive (rules 18 and 22).
The two supplied ands are marked separately because they stand between different pairs of asyndetic clauses (rule 14).
